title: UK album release: Shaved Fish by John Lennon | 1975
content:
John Lennon’s compilation album Shaved Fish was released in the United Kingdom on 24 October 1975.

The only compilation of his non-Beatles songs released during Lennon’s lifetime, Shaved Fish collated 11 of his singles from 1969 to 1974. It brought together all his solo singles released in the US to date, with the exception of ‘Stand By Me’.

Well, hits and misses, I think, and nears. Well, when I realised… That was another thing – was it a subconscious move? Did I know I wasn’t going to be on Capitol and EMI any more? I had no intentions, no thoughts about it. But what I found was, when I went to look for the ‘Cold Turkey’ master tapes, nobody knew where they were. I had to use dubs of ‘Power To The People’ because the tapes had gone, nobody could give a damn at the record companies because they weren’t… you know, that big. Big enough for them to be interested. So what I realised was if I don’t put this Shaved Fish thing together, that’s why I didn’t call it oldies or goldies or the Best of, because it wasn’t – some of them didn’t hardly get any airplay. But I thought if I don’t put this package together, some of the works is just going to go… nobody’s… they will be lost for ever. So I’ve put it together and sort of… at least it’s there now for anybody whose interested.
John Lennon, 6 December 1980
The Lennon Tapes, Andy Peebles

Shaved Fish was released three days later in the United States.
